description: #749 adjacency-is-not-flow and operand-isolation negative controls: an adjacent untrusted-source assignment whose target the construction never uses (request_id near a constant join), an untrusted token with no assignment target at all, an assignment LHS containing request vocabulary (request_cache_path), a static quoted word adjacent to an anchor call (label = "request"), a trailing COMMENT containing request vocabulary, a SIBLING statement donating request.id after a static join, and a BARE filename identifier (trusted constant propagated into a path) are all trusted/clean — path_handling must not fire and the provenance artifact stays empty. Only the construction call's operands are scanned; co-occurrence never substitutes for the one-hop def/use edge.

+filename = "config.json"
